test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting second to the left of C. E is the immediate neighbour of A and C. G is sitting third to the right of D.

What is the position of B with respect to G?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order).

F is sitting second to the left of C. E is the immediate neighbour of A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab3afca7a1820c97f9779ce8e715f46d72830a3539458fb28ec70e68b8afbed8.png] 

 G is sitting third to the right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fdb74211bc87f22a1dae39f660e84ef72636bec330a8efac7a2e658658b44c4.png] 

Thus, B is the Second to the left of G..

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
